name: first_name
label: First name
help: Required with last_name and domain. Give first_name, last_name and domain together, or linkedin_url alone.

name: last_name
label: Last name
help: Required with first_name and domain. Give first_name, last_name and domain together, or linkedin_url alone.

name: domain
label: Company domain
help: For example `example.com`. A full URL also works; looot keeps the host. Required with first_name and last_name. Give first_name, last_name and domain together, or linkedin_url alone.

name: linkedin_url
label: LinkedIn profile URL
help: Enough on its own, for example `https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe`. Give first_name, last_name and domain together, or linkedin_url alone.

name: fallback
label: Try other providers
help: When the first provider finds nothing, looot tries the next provider of the same job. Only the attempts that ran are charged.

name: maxCostUsd
label: Max cost (USD)
help: The most this module may spend across all providers it tries, for example `0.1`. Leave empty for the default cap. Used only when Try other providers is on.

name: wait
label: Wait (seconds)
help: How long to wait for the result, from 0 to 30. A run that takes longer comes back with the status `queued` or `running`; read it later with Get a run.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency key
help: The same key with the same input never pays twice. Leave empty and the module builds one from the input and the date.
